name: Thousand OG card — brand lockup on cream by Thousand
description: A brand-only Open Graph card at roughly 1200×630: one centered lockup — a rounded bracket glyph cradling three pill bars, the longest in amber, beside the wordmark set in an extra-bold rounded sans — floating in a warm cream field with no headline, tagline or URL. Hierarchy comes entirely from the single accent bar and the matching scale of glyph and type; roughly two-thirds of the canvas is empty. Flat fills, a consistent pill radius across glyph and bars, and tight tracking on the heavy type keep it legible even at small share-preview sizes.
